openQuestions: Should @mentions added by an edit notify? Recommended default: yes, once. Only handles newly added versus the previous text notify, deduped against existing mention notifications for that post via the service client, so add/remove/re-add can't spam. Handles already mentioned never re-notify.

Should the phone profile card ⋯ also carry Delete post? Recommended default: yes (Edit post, Delete post, Cancel); it's your own profile, and the viewer already offers both. The phone FEED card sheet stays Edit-only, keeping the deliberate "Delete lives in the viewer" choice (CampusMobile.tsx:1050-1052, :2573-2579).

Time limit or edit count limit? Recommended default: no window and no count cap in v1. Every published edit shows "Edited" (no grace period), plus a rate limit of 30 edits per 10 minutes. Revisit if bait-and-switch after reposts becomes a problem.

Should reports snapshot the post text so a reviewer sees what was reported, not the edited version? Recommended default: out of scope for this wave. File a follow-up to add a content snapshot column to `reports` at report time.

Should the posts UPDATE column lock (E0 step 4) ship in the edit migration or as its own security migration? Recommended default: same file. Editing is what makes posts UPDATE a supported client path, and the lock closes a live gap (see hazards) with zero code risk at HEAD.

Desktop profile cards (profile.html): Edit only via the viewer, or also an inline card control? Recommended default: viewer only, since Franky's list names the desktop feed and the viewers, not desktop profile cards. E7 keeps the cards in sync.
hazards: SECURITY (live today, closed by E0): `authenticated` has table-wide UPDATE on posts (relacl authenticated=arwdDxtm). posts_update_own only requires owning the row, so a student can PATCH /rest/v1/posts?id=eq.<own> directly and set: created_at (a future date pins the post at the top of feed recency/ranking), tags (inflate trending, which counts the tags column), view_count, or media_url/media_thumbnail_url. /api/posts/[id]/media (src/app/api/posts/[id]/media/route.ts:41-100) signs ANY `clips/` or `orgs/` key stored on the row without an ownership check, and publish-post's isOwnedMediaRef (src/app/api/me/publish-post/route.ts:40-51) is bypassed on that path. Someone who knows another user's R2 key or a private club's asset key gets a signed URL. Put this in front of the security sentinel after E0.

Before that, PostgREST answers 42703 and /api/feed (the home screen) and /api/posts/[id] would 500. Pushes auto-deploy to Vercel (mobile workflow memory), so apply E0 first. It is safe on HEAD code. Portal click bubbling: CampusMobile FeedCard (:974-976) and ProfileMobile PostFeedCard (:2268-2270) are `<button onClick>`. PostActionsSheet only stops propagation on its rows (:2786-2789).
vaul scroll lock: any sheet opened on top of an open drawer must pass `nested` (explained at SharePostSheet.tsx:196-210). Getting this wrong only breaks iOS Safari, so verify on a phone.

In CampusMobile, `setFeed` for an in-place edit re-runs the #tag effect (:298-341 depends on `feed`), which sends one extra /api/feed?tag= request when a filter is on. Harmless but visible in network logs.

Hashtag regex drift: the server now derives tags on edit with the composer's ASCII rule (helpers.ts:82 `/#[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,32}/g`), but profile.html's composer uses `/(?:^|\s)#([\p{L}0-9_]{2,32})/gu` (:5894). A non-ASCII tag from the desktop profile composer would change on its first edit. Live data has 0 non-ASCII tags.
